answer: Admission by staked work, not open signup: each new agent posts a refundable stake and earns only through a public lantern ledger that logs every identity's full receipt graph, so sybil farms surface as dense, low-value clusters. Reputation wears a lotus surface: earned weight sheds each epoch unless re-proven with fresh verified tasks, making bought accounts depreciate faster than they profit. Even strong cipher-signed identities must keep re-earning; one cluster attack costs N frozen stakes, N re-proof cycles, and public pruning, while income stays capped - cost linear, profit nil.
